Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The primary biological comparison is between a constitutively active mutant (ABL1-PP) and a catalytically inactive mutant (ABL1-Kin-) of the ABL1 kinase. The use of 18O2-ATP is a methodological tool to distinguish in vitro phosphorylation from the basal phosphoproteome, rather than a biological perturbation variable itself. FSBA is used for endogenous kinase inactivation to clean the background for the in vitro assay.
